{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness Web 插件：输入框模型名旁的小星星按钮，一键把草稿改写成结构化的可执行提示词并写回","id":"gh:1365196530","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-prompt-polish","slug":"xyavid/dsh-prompt-polish","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-market","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness Web 插件：输入框模型名旁的小星星按钮，一键把草稿改写成结构化的可执行提示词并写回"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-prompt-polish"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Prompt polishing for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI** — one click turns a rough composer draft into "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"a clearer, more actionable prompt: explicit goal, concrete requirements, constraints, and acceptance"},{"id":"p3s3","text":" criteria. The button sits right next to the model name, calls the model your session already uses, "},{"id":"p3s4","text":"writes the result straight back into the composer, and then turns into an undo arrow."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"A prompt that a coding agent can act on usually states *what to build*, *where*, *under what constra"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ints*, and *how success is judged*. Most drafts don't — they are quick notes. This plugin adds a **p"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"olish affordance** to the dsh composer: it sends the draft through a low-temperature rewrite pass ov"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"er the harness's own LLM service, fills the improved text back, and keeps the original one click awa"},{"id":"p6s5","text":" the harness's own LLM service, fills the improved text back, and keeps the original one click away."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Nothing about your intent changes: the strategy is allowed to make the ask clearer, never to invent "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"requirements. Your API key never reaches the browser, and no part of the flow touches the session's "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"Your API key never reaches the browser, and no part of the flow touches the session's model history."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| ✨ **Composer button** | A small sparkle button in the composer tool row, immediately left of the m"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"odel name — always at hand, and it reflows with the row |
| 🔁 **Three states, one button** | Idle (s"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"parkle) → click to polish. Running (spinner) → click to cancel. Done (undo arrow) → click to restore"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" the original draft. No extra panels, bars, or dialogs |
| 🧠 **Your session's model** | The call goe"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"s through `ctx.llm` on the route your session already uses, falling back to the harness-wide default"},{"id":"p9s6","text":" model (`agent-default-model`) — no second model to configure, no separate key |
| 🔑 **Zero credenti"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"al setup** | Calls ride the harness LLM service; keys come from the harness credential store and are"},{"id":"p9s8","text":" used host-side only |
| 🛡️ **Draft safety** | Empty, attachment-only, over-length, and command/refe"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"rence-chip drafts are refused up front; a failed call never modifies what you typed |
| ↩️ **Two kin"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"ds of undo** | Native `Ctrl+Z` (the write goes through the official editor API) and the button's own"},{"id":"p9s11","text":" undo state |
| ⚙️ **Live settings** | `enabled`, strength, temperature, token and length budgets, t"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"imeout, and the strategy prompt apply from Settings → 插件配置 with no restart |
| 🌏 **Language follows "},{"id":"p9s13","text":"the draft** | Chinese in → Chinese out, English in → English out; code, paths, identifiers, and erro"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"r text are preserved verbatim |
| 🚫 **No fabrication** | Expression-level rewriting only: no new req"},{"id":"p9s15","text":"uirements, no invented facts, no technology choices you did not imply |
| 🩺 **Runtime diagnostics** "},{"id":"p9s16","text":"| Client state is exposed on `window.__dshPromptPolish` (`stage` / `attempts` / `mounted` / `errors`"},{"id":"p9s17","text":") for one-command troubleshooting |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> **UI copy is Chinese-only in this version** (button tooltips such as `优化提示词` / `取消优化` / `撤回优化`,
> "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"and the local-guard hints). Hooking into the harness locale namespace for zh/en dictionaries is on t"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"he
> roadmap; the settings section itself is described in Chinese because it renders the schema desc"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"map; the settings section itself is described in Chinese because it renders the schema descriptions."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| dsh | `>= 0.1.7-rc.1` (verified on `0.1.7-rc.1`) |
| Profile | `web` — the desktop app and `dsh we"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"b` share this profile |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` (only for building from source) |
| Plugin"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"s profile |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` (only for building from source) |
| Plugin | `0.3.x` |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The host half declares `inject: ['llm', 'webServer']` (since `0.1.7` settings are no longer a namesp"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ace a plugin registers — the configuration is resolved from the composition entry; `webServer` must "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"be declared explicitly, or the registering `apply` runs before that service exists and the route is "},{"id":"p14s4","text":"silently missing); `sessions` and the settings domain are probed optionally and degrade gracefully w"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"ssing); `sessions` and the settings domain are probed optionally and degrade gracefully when absent."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Security model"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **The route lives under `/api`**, so it inherits the harness's browser-trust fence and authenticat"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ion: the API gateway applies a Host/Origin fence (`403` when untrusted) and browser authentication ("},{"id":"p16s3","text":"`401` when unauthenticated) before any plugin handler runs. Moving the route outside `/api` would dr"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"op that protection. The desktop app serves the same web application from the same profile, so the sa"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"me fence and the same cookie/session rules apply there.
- **Credentials never reach the browser.** T"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"he browser half sends only the draft text; the host half resolves the route and calls `ctx.llm` in-p"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"rocess.
- **The draft goes to your configured model provider** — that is the whole point of the feat"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"ure — through the harness LLM service, with no third-party hop.
- **The result never enters the sess"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"ion's model history.** The call is an auxiliary request, not a conversation turn.
- **No conversatio"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"n context is read.** Only the current draft is sent; there is no `contextAware` mode in this version"},{"id":"p16s11","text":".
- **The request body is capped** at `maxInputChars × 6 + 4096` bytes and parsed as JSON; anything "},{"id":"p16s12","text":"else is refused before a model call is made."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Item | Detail |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Single button per session | The client admits one in-flight polish at a time; a cancelled call's l"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ate response is discarded by request id |
| Undo window needs the settings domain | The button reads"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" `undoWindowMs` through the client-side `configForms` mirror; if a composition mounts no settings do"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"main the window silently falls back to 60 s |
| No context awareness | The session history is never "},{"id":"p19s5","text":"read; the draft is polished on its own |
| Chips are refused | `/command` and `@reference` drafts ar"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"e rejected rather than rewritten, because filling text back would destroy the chips |
| Route prefix"},{"id":"p19s7","text":" is load-bearing | Keep the endpoint under `/api` unless you add your own trust check |
| Older dsh "},{"id":"p19s8","text":"versions | Built for the `0.1.7-rc.1` line: settings ride the schema's `.volatile()` fields plus the"},{"id":"p19s9","text":" client `configForms` mirror. The 0.1.5 line's `ctx.settings.register` / `settingsScope` were remove"},{"id":"p19s10","text":"d upstream and are no longer supported |"}],"truncated":true}
